# Abolqasem 1.4.5

## Reliable startup and settings

- Settings pages now show a structured loading state while the first server snapshot arrives, instead of blank or default-looking forms.
- A stalled local WebSocket request now times out, reconnects, and presents a retry action rather than leaving the interface indefinitely pending.
- Previously received settings remain visible while the server reconnects.
- Startup splash no longer deliberately waits for a long presentation delay.

## Telegram and local runtime

- Telegram configuration is now owned by Abolqasem at `~/.config/abolqasem/telegram-bridge.json`; existing configuration is migrated safely and retained at its old path for rollback.
- `abolqasem restart` preserves Telegram configuration.
- Install and update continue to install the persistent server together with both Codex and Claude hooks; update no longer performs a redundant second restart.

## Usage

- Usage limits render independently of the heavier local disk scan, so the Usage screen becomes useful immediately.
